description: PART 3 -- Delete the orphan ff-dataset-catalog crate and re-express the governance rules that named it, so ff-governance-tests still passes AND encodes the intent (ff-dscatalog is the single authority; the DAG stays acyclic). Mirrors the RC.B.7 ff-vsam-services retirement EXACTLY (.agents/tasks/rcb7-vsam-wiring/feat003-finish-note.md). Delivers dataset-catalog Task 42.1/42.2 (Req 35.1a/c/d, 35.2) and ownership Req 22.1/22.2. Runs LAST: depends on FEAT-001 (no shipping crate may have ff-dataset-catalog as a Cargo dep).
steps: Read context.json, plan.md Part 3, and the precedent .agents/tasks/rcb7-vsam-wiring/feat003-finish-note.md FIRST.

PRE-CHECK (must pass before deleting): grep_search 'ff-dataset-catalog' and 'ff_dataset_catalog' across **/*.toml and **/*.rs. Expect only: root Cargo.toml member line; the crate's own tree; ff-governance-tests compliance.rs + architecture_compliance.rs; stale doc prose. Confirm NO shipping crate (incl. ff-idcams after FEAT-001) has it as a Cargo dependency. If a real Cargo dep is found, STOP and report (do not delete).

Delete the crate: remove the directory crates/ff-dataset-catalog/ (entire tree) and remove the '"crates/ff-dataset-catalog",' entry from root Cargo.toml [workspace].members (~line 57). Cargo.lock regenerates on the next scoped cargo check.

Re-express crates/ff-governance-tests/src/compliance.rs: remove the ff-vfs -> ff-dataset-catalog DependencyRule and the two ff-dataset-catalog -> ff-idcams / -> ff-dsalloc DependencyRules. The acyclic/catalog intent stays covered by the surviving ff-vfs -> ff-idcams, ff-vfs -> ff-dsalloc, and ff-dsalloc -> ff-idcams rules (same reasoning RC.B.7 used). Do not invent new rules.

Re-express crates/ff-governance-tests/tests/architecture_compliance.rs: in vfs_has_no_domain_dependencies remove the !deps.contains_key("ff-dataset-catalog") assertion; DELETE the whole dataset_catalog_has_no_upstream_dependencies test; remove "ff-dataset-catalog" from the dataset_crates array in prohibited_rules_cover_all_dataset_crates; remove the ("ff-dataset-catalog", true) entry from required_crates in all_governed_crates_exist.
Confirm crates/ff-governance-tests/tests/mock_compilation.rs has no residual ff_dataset_catalog import (already on ff-dscatalog; re-verify it compiles).

Fix stale .rs doc comments / specs prose that name ff-dataset-catalog as the catalog AUTHORITY -> ff-dscatalog (prioritise .rs doc comments). Leave genuine historical record (RC.B.7 note, RESUME history, change-log) untouched.
Run the scoped checks (cargo test -p ff-governance-tests is THE KEY CHECK). Final grep: zero live ff-dataset-catalog/ff_dataset_catalog in any *.toml/*.rs.

Flip TCR dataset-catalog Req 35.1a/c/d + 35.2 and ownership Req 22.1/22.2 to reflect the deletion + re-expressed governance (mirror RC.B.7 wording). Mark dataset-catalog tasks.md Task 42.1/42.2 [x]. Update docs/project-management/project-master/tasks.md RC.B.8 row and docs/status/RESUME-dataset-rationalisation.md (RC.B.8 done-pending-gate; Part 2 deferred). Record findings in FEAT-003.json.
acceptance_criteria: crates/ff-dataset-catalog/ directory and its root Cargo.toml [workspace].members entry are removed; grep finds no live ff-dataset-catalog/ff_dataset_catalog in any *.toml or *.rs (Req 35.2, 22.1).
cargo test -p ff-governance-tests is GREEN after the rule edits (architecture_compliance + mock_compilation).
cargo check -p ff-desktop --all-targets is clean (the app closure builds without the crate).
The acyclic-DAG / single-authority intent remains encoded by the surviving governance rules (Req 22.2).
TCR rows and tasks.md entries for Task 42 / ownership Req 22.1/22.2 are updated; the RC.B.8 master row and RESUME doc note the deferred Part 2.
verification: C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "cargo check -p ff-governance-tests -p ff-dscatalog -p ff-dsalloc -p ff-idcams --all-targets"
grep_search 'ff-dataset-catalog|ff_dataset_catalog' across **/*.toml and **/*.rs returns no live references
